## Functions

### `entasis_body_property_init`

initializes a dense type-erased body property table

capacity is an initial hint and may be zero. a NULL allocator selects the runtime heap. ownership: caller owned. keep the table at a stable address until destroy

```c
ENTASIS_API entasis_status_t ENTASIS_CALL entasis_body_property_init(entasis_body_property_table_t * table, uint64_t value_size, uint64_t value_alignment, uint64_t initial_capacity, const entasis_allocator_t * allocator, entasis_diagnostic_t * diagnostic);
```

| Parameter          | C type                            | Meaning                                                                                                                          |
| ------------------ | --------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `table`            | `entasis_body_property_table_t *` | target body property table                                                                                                       |
| `value_size`       | `uint64_t`                        | size of one property value in bytes                                                                                              |
| `value_alignment`  | `uint64_t`                        | required alignment of one property value in bytes                                                                                |
| `initial_capacity` | `uint64_t`                        | initial retained capacity                                                                                                        |
| `allocator`        | `const entasis_allocator_t *`     | copied allocator callbacks for storage covered by the selected allocation scope. user_context remains borrowed until destruction |
| `diagnostic`       | `entasis_diagnostic_t *`          | optional diagnostic output, or NULL when detailed failure data is not needed                                                     |

returns ENTASIS_STATUS_OK on success or a failure status

### `entasis_body_property_set`

sets one body property value

creating a missing value begins a new generation. updating a present value preserves existing keys. allocation may occur only when the handle index exceeds current capacity

```c
ENTASIS_API entasis_status_t ENTASIS_CALL entasis_body_property_set(entasis_body_property_table_t * table, entasis_body_handle_t handle, const void * value, entasis_diagnostic_t * diagnostic);
```

| Parameter    | C type                            | Meaning                                                                      |
| ------------ | --------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `table`      | `entasis_body_property_table_t *` | target body property table                                                   |
| `handle`     | `entasis_body_handle_t`           | target body handle                                                           |
| `value`      | `const void *`                    | property bytes to copy                                                       |
| `diagnostic` | `entasis_diagnostic_t *`          | optional diagnostic output, or NULL when detailed failure data is not needed |

returns ENTASIS_STATUS_OK on success or a failure status
